objective: Review the fixes applied to Data Quality Profiler v0.1.0 addressing all findings from the prior ChatGPT→Hermes review handoff.
summary: Applied all 6 review findings from chatgpt-data-quality-profiler-review-fixes-2026-08-18 using TDD. All fixes verified with new tests (53/53 pass, up from 44/44). Key changes: (1) near_constant now uses VALUE frequency not TYPE frequency, (2) recursive stable canonicalization for duplicates and distinct_count, (3) CSV empty cells propagate format to profileField as missing, (4) scoring_version exposed in public API envelope, (5) config rejects non-Sepolia networks, (6) custom x402 plugin replaced with official @x402/fastify middleware + fake facilitator tests.

fixes_applied.finding: near_constant computed from dominant TYPE frequency instead of VALUE frequency
fixes_applied.fix: deriveNearConstant now takes nonMissing items, counts value frequencies via String coercion, and compares dominant value count to threshold
fixes_applied.tests_added: 3 tests in test/infer.test.mjs: distinct strings not near-constant, >=95% repeated value is near-constant, <10 rows not near-constant

fixes_applied.finding: Duplicate detection and distinct_count use JS reference identity for objects/arrays
fixes_applied.fix: Created shared recursive stable canonicalize() utility. Duplicate detection in profile.mjs uses it. distinct_count in infer.mjs uses it via Set of canonicalized strings.
fixes_applied.tests_added: 5 tests: nested key-order duplicates, different-nested-values non-duplicates, deep nesting canonicalization, distinct_count objects, distinct_count arrays

fixes_applied.finding: CSV empty cells not counted as missing
fixes_applied.fix: profileDataset now extracts format from normalized output and passes { isCsv: format === 'csv' } to profileField
fixes_applied.tests_added: 3 tests in test/csv-missing.test.mjs: CSV empty cells missing, format propagation, JSON empty string not missing

fixes_applied.finding: scoring_version not in public API envelope
fixes_applied.fix: Added scoring_version field to the reply.send() envelope, sourced from scoreProfile() return value
fixes_applied.tests_added: 1 assertion added to existing envelope test in test/api.test.mjs

fixes_applied.finding: Config allows arbitrary non-Sepolia, non-Base networks
fixes_applied.fix: Added ALLOWED_NETWORKS set containing only eip155:84532; any other network throws 'not an allowed network'
fixes_applied.tests_added: 2 tests in test/config.test.mjs: rejects eip155:1 and eip155:137, allows eip155:84532

fixes_applied.finding: Custom x402 header checker instead of official @x402/fastify middleware
fixes_applied.fix: Replaced custom verifyX402Header with official x402ResourceServer + ExactEvmScheme + paymentMiddleware from @x402/fastify. Uses HTTPFacilitatorClient with syncFacilitatorOnStart=true. Fake facilitator tests for /supported, /verify, /settle.
fixes_applied.tests_added: 3 tests in test/x402-plugin.test.mjs: health free, unpaid returns 402 with base64 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header (x402Version=2, exact scheme, eip155:84532, correct payTo and amount), disabled plugin bypass. Removed payments.test.mjs arbitrary-signature-as-proof tests.
fixes_applied.handoff_requirement_met: HTTP 402 with PAYMENT-REQUIRED response header decoded to x402Version 2, scheme exact, network eip155:84532, correct payTo, $0.02 = 20000 amount. No fabricated header unlocks 200.

limitations: No real facilitator verification, signature settlement, wallet funding, USDC transfer, marketplace listing, hosting purchase, or Coinbase action was performed.
Base mainnet and every other mainnet remain unauthorized. Testnet/local behavior only.
The @x402/fastify middleware syncs with the facilitator on the first protected request; the fake facilitator used in tests returns a minimal supported-kinds response.
Do not expand scope to /compare, LLM features, URL fetching, document conversion, or additional products.
